unit.why: A single narrative: the Maggid of Mezeritch surveys Frankfurt supernaturally for 2 hours and permits the Ba'al Hafla'ah to move there; it is followed by a short transitional editorial sentence.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with an editorial transition ('לא אמנע הטוב להציג...') introducing the sayings that follow in the next division

stories.start_quote: שהגה"ק ההפלאה אמר להמגיד הק' ממעזריטש
stories.summary_en: The Ba'al Hafla'ah fears to move to Frankfurt lest its people be not kosher; the Maggid of Mezeritch turns up his eyes for two hours, 'visits' every house there, sees no evil, and permits the move.
